description: ptscry - Guido Cauli <guido.cauli@gmail.com> - audit JSON record (file or syslog) to ECS-style fields

script.description: Mark refusals and failures as ECS failures
script.source: if (ctx.ptscry != null && ctx.ptscry.event != null) { String e = ctx.ptscry.event; if (e == 'access_denied' || e == 'limit_reached' || e == 'rate_limited' || e == 'record_error' || e == 'config_reload_failed' || e == 'host_flood' || e == 'launch_failed' || e == 'fe_denied' || e == 'fe_totp_failed' || e == 'fe_totp_locked' || e == 'frontend_exit' || e == 'frontend_config_error' || e == 'monitor_reexec_failed' || e == 'monitor_resume_failed') { ctx.event.outcome = 'failure'; } }
